In summary, we have described a highly eficient electro-
chemical synthetic method for spirocyclic 2,5-dihydrofuran
derivatives from allenols. This approach operates under metal
catalyst-free and exogenous oxidant-free conditions, utilizing
commercially available and nontoxic KBr as the brominating
source. The method enjoys ease of handling and mild reaction
conditions preventing racemization with the optically active
substrates. Further studies in this area including control of the
cyclization mode are currently ongoing in our laboratory.
